symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach server in VLAN 30; gateway ping works
topology_note: VLAN30 SVI up, trunk to core
show_output: show ip route: no entry for 10.0.30.0; show access-lists: ACL 101 applied inbound

symptom: Two PCs on same VLAN report intermittent connectivity and MAC flapping
show_output: show ip interface brief: two hosts both configured 192.168.10.10

symptom: New host cannot get an IP address via DHCP
show_output: show ip dhcp binding: pool empty; show run | section dhcp: pool exhausted

symptom: Host can reach gateway but nothing beyond it
show_output: show interfaces: Gi0/1 mask 255.255.255.0 on host vs 255.255.255.128 on gateway
expected_fault: Subnet mask mismatch between host and gateway

symptom: PC in VLAN50 cannot resolve external hostnames but IP connectivity works
show_output: show run | include dns; nslookup fails, ping to 8.8.8.8 succeeds

symptom: Trunk link between switches drops VLAN 60 traffic only
show_output: show interfaces trunk: VLAN 60 not in allowed list
expected_fault: VLAN not permitted on trunk allowed list

symptom: Router will not route between VLAN 70 and VLAN 80
show_output: show ip interface brief: Gi0/0.80 administratively down

symptom: Internal hosts cannot reach the internet despite valid default route
show_output: show ip nat translations: empty; show run | section nat: acl not referenced in nat overload
expected_fault: NAT ACL misconfigured or not applied

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi clients can reach internal file server
topology_note: WLAN guest SSID mapped to VLAN 90
show_output: show vlan brief: guest SSID mapped to VLAN 10 instead of 90; no isolation ACL
expected_fault: Guest isolation failure / wrong VLAN mapping

symptom: Static route configured but traffic still fails to reach remote subnet
topology_note: Router R1 to R2 static route
show_output: show ip route: route present but next-hop unreachable; show cdp neighbors: R2 interface down
show interfaces Gi0/3: line protocol down

symptom: ACL blocks legitimate return traffic for a web request
Wireless clients get IP but cannot reach wired VLAN
show_output: show vlan brief: AP port not trunked, only access VLAN 1

symptom: OSPF neighbors not forming between two routers
topology_note: R1 and R2 on shared segment
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: empty; show run: mismatched area IDs

show_output: show mac address-table: no entry learned for host MAC
expected_fault: Port security or MAC learning issue
